remake.tutorial.title: Training run
remake.tutorial.offer.title: New on the bridge?
remake.tutorial.offer.text: A short training run shows the bridge, the five departments and your first fight, step by step. The clock stops while I explain.
remake.tutorial.offer.note: You can start it any time from the title screen or Settings.
remake.tutorial.welcome: Welcome aboard, Captain. Ship's computer speaking. This is a training run with a seasoned crew, course: {destination}. While I explain, the clock stops; it runs again when you give an order.
remake.tutorial.strip: The status strip: speed; position on the route (50 = arrival); minutes in flight and the schedule; cargo; power (green = produced, amber = drawn); shield battery.
remake.tutorial.view: The viewscreen. Ships show up at four bearings: port, fore and starboard on the big screen, aft in the small inset. Tapping a ship opens the fire order.
remake.tutorial.depts: Five officers run five departments: Weapons, Scanners, Navigation, Engineering, Repair. They act on their own, but slowly and not always wisely — your orders come first.
remake.tutorial.depts.phone: Switch departments with the tabs at the bottom.
remake.tutorial.eng: Engineering. The reactors make 1200 units of power, and devices get it in this priority order. By default Shields and Weapons come first and the Engines get the leftovers: the ship crawls and stays under fire longer. Drag “{engines}” to the top by its ⋮⋮ handle.
remake.tutorial.speed: Navigation. Now full speed: tap 8 on the throttle.
remake.tutorial.evasive: Evasive manoeuvres make the enemy miss more often, but the ship flies slower. Switch them on under fire and off when the sky is clear.
remake.tutorial.runContact: Full speed ahead. Fast-forwarding until the scanners pick something up.
remake.tutorial.contact: Contact! Every ship gets a letter — this one is {letter}. Friend or pirate? The scanners will tell.
remake.tutorial.msg: Officers report here. A lit lamp (or a number on a tab) means messages are waiting. Tap “{next}” to read one.
remake.tutorial.slow: Here is the catch: at full speed the engines eat all the power, and Scanners and Weapons get none — they can neither examine nor shoot. For a fight, slow down: tap 2.
remake.tutorial.scan: Scanners. Contacts on the examination list are studied in order: first the lock (needed to shoot), then the class, the damage and the weakness — the weapon that hurts this ship most (★). {letter} is on the list.
remake.tutorial.aDone: {letter} is a {ship}: {side}. Never fire at friends — lost allies are deducted from your pay.
remake.tutorial.examB: A new contact: {letter}. Tap “{examine}” to put it on the examination list.
remake.tutorial.bDone: {letter} is a {ship}, a pirate, and it has turned hostile. It is locked, and the scanners found its weak spot: {weapon} ★.
remake.tutorial.bGone: {letter} slipped away. No matter — on to repairs.
remake.tutorial.fireWeapon: Choose the weapon marked ★: {weapon}. Shots “∞” means fire at will until the target is gone.
remake.tutorial.runFire: Fighting {letter}: the gunner fires by your order.
remake.tutorial.killed: Target destroyed — the bounty goes on your invoice. When the sky is clear, speed up again: then the weapons need no power.
remake.tutorial.missed: {letter} got away this time. Pirates come back — be ready.
remake.tutorial.repair: Repair. A training fault: the “{system}” system is damaged. Tap it in the list of damaged systems.
remake.tutorial.repairSheet: Choose how many robodroids to send (more droids repair faster but leave fewer for other jobs) and tap “{assign}”.
remake.tutorial.repDone: The droids are on it. In the repair queue ⋮⋮ reorders and ✕ cancels a job. If the cargo climate system or the stabiliser breaks down, the cargo spoils every few seconds — repair them first.
remake.tutorial.schedule: The voyage ends at position 50: you are paid for the cargo delivered, the bounties and an early bonus. It is aborted if the cargo is lost or you are 60 minutes late. Watch the time and the cargo here.
remake.tutorial.done: Training complete, Captain. From now on tips pop up the first time something new happens, and “?” on every panel explains it. Fly on or return to the title?
remake.tutorial.runPower: The ship slows down and Engineering shares out the power again…
remake.tutorial.power: Not enough power for: {who}. “{e}” and “{f}” are ahead of them in the priority list. Drag those two rows down by ⋮⋮.
remake.tutorial.examA: Scanners. {letter} is not on the examination list yet — tap “{examine}”.
remake.tutorial.orders: The order is on the fire list. Orders run top to bottom: drag ⋮⋮ to reorder, ✕ cancels. The status on the right tells whether the weapon can fire right now.
remake.tutorial.shields: Pirates shoot back. The shields absorb hits while the shield battery holds (“Shield” on the status strip); once it is empty, hits damage the ship’s systems. Evasive manoeuvres make the enemy miss more often.
remake.tips.title: Tip
remake.tips.contact: First contact. The scanners will examine it: lock, class, weakness. Friend or foe shows in the colour of its letter in the contacts list (red = foe).
remake.tips.hostile: A hostile ship! Make sure Scanners and Weapons have power (slow down if needed) and fire the ★ weapon as soon as it is locked.
remake.tips.hit: We're hit! The shields absorb hits while the shield battery lasts. Evasive manoeuvres (Navigation) make the enemy miss more often.
remake.tips.power: Power overload: the devices want more than the reactors give, so the lowest in the priority list go without. In Engineering raise what matters now, slow down, or switch off devices you don't need.
remake.tips.destroyed: A system has been destroyed — it's gone for good. Damaged and broken systems can still be repaired: send robodroids before it's too late.
remake.tips.stressed: An officer is under stress: slower work, more mistakes. Their portrait is tinted.
remake.tips.dead: We've lost an officer. That department now has a reduced menu and works much worse.
remake.tips.late: We're behind schedule: being late costs money, and 60 minutes late the voyage is aborted. Speed up or choose a shorter course in Navigation.
remake.tips.cargo: We're losing cargo! A broken cargo climate system or stabiliser spoils it every few seconds — repair them first. At 0% the voyage is over.
remake.help.title: How to play
remake.help.goal.title: Goal
remake.help.goal.text: Deliver the cargo to the destination (position 50). Pay = cargo delivered + bounties for pirates + early bonus, minus casualties, lost allies and repairs. The voyage is aborted if the cargo is lost or you are 60 minutes late.
remake.help.bridge.title: The bridge
remake.help.bridge.text: The status strip on top, the viewscreen, officer messages and the five department panels. Time runs in real time; ❚❚ pauses. Every order takes a moment to process.
remake.help.msg.title: Officer messages
remake.help.msg.text: The lamps W S N E R (numbers on the tabs on a phone) light up when an officer has something to say. “Next” reads the fullest queue, “Clear” drops them all, “Auto answer” shows them by itself.
remake.help.weapons.what: Fires missiles, blasters, cannons and thermos at locked targets, in the order of the firing list.
remake.help.weapons.controls: “Fire” (or tap a ship on the viewscreen): target, number of shots (∞ = at will) and weapon. Drag ⋮⋮ to change the priority, ✕ cancels an order.
remake.help.weapons.tips: Use the ★ weapon the Scanners found: it hits much harder. Weapons need power and a lock; an order's status says why it isn't firing.
remake.help.scanning.what: Detects ships and examines them one by one: lock, class, damage, weakness.
remake.help.scanning.controls: “Examine” on a contact puts it on the examination list; ⋮⋮ reorders, ✕ removes. “Fire” opens the fire order.
remake.help.scanning.tips: Without power the scanners examine nothing. Put the nearest foes first and drop finished targets.
remake.help.navigation.controls: Throttle STOP…8 and the “Evasive” switch. Five courses with distance, arrival time, schedule deviation and risk; tap one to change course.
remake.help.navigation.tips: Faster means earlier and a bigger bonus, but the engines eat power. Evade under fire: fewer hits, less speed. Don't sit still with systems unpowered — looters board idle ships.
remake.help.engineering.what: Shares the reactor power (1200 units) among the devices.
remake.help.engineering.controls: Switches for the twelve devices. Power priority: drag the classes, the top ones are fed first. The emergency battery adds power while its charge lasts.
remake.help.engineering.tips: By default the engines come after Shields and Weapons, so the ship crawls. Cruising: engines on top. Fighting: shields, weapons and scanners first, and slow down.
remake.help.repair.what: Robodroids repair damaged and broken systems; destroyed ones are lost for good.
remake.help.repair.controls: Tap a damaged system, choose 1–7 droids and “Assign”. The repair queue works top-down; ⋮⋮ reorders, ✕ cancels.
remake.help.repair.tips: Cargo climate and stabiliser first (the cargo!), then life support, reactors and engines. More droids work faster but leave fewer for other jobs.
remake.tutorial.exitTitle: End the training and keep flying
remake.tutorial.exitConfirm: Leave the training? The voyage goes on as a normal game. You can replay the training from the title screen or Settings.
